## Decisions
- No left-border accent on cards → user called it "AI slop"
- Status chips over dots → word labels (Blocked/Stale/Idle/Active/Done) are the primary read
- Health arc circle → 24px SVG ring, green ≥70, amber ≥40, red <40
- CSS grid for heatmap → `grid-template-columns: repeat(53, 1fr)` fills container like GitHub profile
- Lifecycle sort → Blocked first, then Active, Idle, Stale, Done; most recent within tier
- Cut treemap → empty for many users, no CTA possible
- Merged Shipped into Lifecycle header → overlapped with lifecycle bars
- Pagination over scroll → 5 items per page with prev/next in SectionCard action slot
- Underscore-prefix ignore in eslint → `argsIgnorePattern: "^_"` for Express error handlers
